name: Benidorm Fun Town Tycoon
desc:
🌴 Welcome to Benidorm — the most fun city in the world! ☀️

The official Benidorm Fun Town Tycoon is here! The Mayor needs YOU — the world's most famous architect — to grow a magical skyscraper from an enchanted seed. Plant it, build it floor by floor and unlock a Mediterranean food market, a stunning Aquarium with water rides, and a sky-high Theme Park on the rooftop!

🏖️ Step outside and explore real Benidorm:
🌊 Beach & Coast — sunbathe and build sandcastles
🤿 Diving — snorkel or become a mermaid
🏞️ Serra Gelada — replant forests and meet wildlife
🏛️ Old Town — discover the city's history
🛹 Sports — bike across the streets

🎢 Scream on the Roller Coaster, fly on the Ferris Wheel, splash in the Mermaid Pool and complete daily quests with Captain Pedro Z to earn x2 Seed boosts!

📱 PC, Xbox, tablet and mobile. New surprises coming soon!
